name: What are the common uses for a backyard tiny home?

mainEntity.name: What are the common uses for a backyard tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Backyard tiny homes offer versatile living solutions. Popular uses include housing for aging parents or adult children, dedicated home offices or creative studios, short-term or long-term rental income opportunities, and guest accommodations. They can also serve as a private retreat or a flexible space for hobbies. Zen Tiny Homes designs units to maximize functionality and adapt to your evolving needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common uses for backyard tiny homes include housing family, home offices, rental income, and guest accommodations, offering versatile living solutions.
